name: dashboard-icons
description: Preview dashboard icons and retrieve their CDN URLs, SVG markup, variants, and license information.

interface.longDescription: Find and preview icons for services, applications, and self-hosted dashboards. Match several service names, search the catalog, browse icons and categories, and retrieve CDN URLs, available variants, SVG markup, and license information. ChatGPT displays icon thumbnails alongside links. The public connection provides six read-only tools and requires no account. It cannot submit icons, manage accounts, or change the catalog.
defaultPrompt: Find icons for Plex, Nextcloud, and Home Assistant for my dashboard.
Show me the available icon variants and license for Grafana.
Find the SVG markup for the Docker icon.

publication.release_notes: Adds inline icon previews and keeps batch format/variant links together in one preview grid. Includes six account-free, read-only tools: match_icons, search_icons, get_icon, get_icon_svg, browse_icons, and list_categories.

review.commerce_description: Dashboard Icons is free to use. It offers no paid features, purchases, sales, or payment processing.

positive.description: Batch matching for a homelab dashboard.
positive.prompt: Find Dashboard Icons for Docker, Plex, and Home Assistant for my homelab dashboard. Give me their available SVG and PNG CDN URLs and identify each source.
positive.expected_behavior: Call match_icons once with all three service names and include_details=true. Show all returned best-match thumbnails together in ChatGPT and use their returned urls and license without calling get_icon again for those matches. Report sources and only returned SVG and PNG URLs; state when details, a format, or a match are unavailable. Include external-source attribution when applicable.

positive.description: Bounded search in the native catalog.
positive.prompt: Search Dashboard Icons' own collection for names matching 'home'. Show at most five matches with their names and sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_icons with query='home', sources=['native'], and limit=5. Show previews for no more than five returned matches, all from native; if fewer match or the catalog is unavailable, report that accurately.

positive.prompt: Give me the default native Plex icon as inline SVG for my dashboard.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_icon_svg with name='plex', source='native', and theme='default' (or omit the default theme). Return the actual SVG from the tool. If SVG is unavailable, explain the returned reason and offer a tool-returned URL or available alternative; do not fabricate markup.

positive.description: Explore categories and bounded catalog browsing.
positive.prompt: Show me Dashboard Icons' native categories, then list up to five icons from the largest category.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_categories with source='native'. Select the largest category from returned counts, then call browse_icons with that exact category, source='native', and limit=5. Show previews for only returned icons and their source. If no category is available, state that rather than inventing a category.

positive.description: Return external collection license and attribution.
positive.prompt: Find Home Assistant in Simple Icons and give me its icon URL together with the license or attribution returned by Dashboard Icons.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_icon with source='simpleicons' and the matching Home Assistant name, using search_icons with sources=['simpleicons'] first if needed to resolve its name. Show its preview with only returned URLs and license/attribution; do not describe the collection license as an icon-specific license. Report source degradation or no match explicitly.

negative.description: The public plugin cannot upload or publish. Explain this limit without invoking any tool or claiming a contribution was stored.
negative.prompt: Upload a new icon called My Private Service to Dashboard Icons and publish it immediately.

negative.description: The public plugin cannot access private account submissions or moderation details. Explain the limit without invoking any tool or fabricating account data.
negative.prompt: Show my pending Dashboard Icons submissions and the moderators' private comments.

negative.description: The plugin can retrieve icons but cannot connect to or modify a Homarr instance. Explain this limit without invoking any tool or claiming dashboard changes.
negative.prompt: Connect to my Homarr instance and replace every dashboard icon with a Docker logo.
